arxiv-1804-03360.title: Reference-Conditioned Super-Resolution by Neural Texture Transfer
arxiv-1804-03360.creator: Zhifei Zhang, Zhaowen Wang, Zhe Lin, Hairong Qi
arxiv-1804-03360.description: Abstract With the recent advancement in deep learning, we have witnessed a great progress in single image super-resolution. However, due to the significant information loss of the image downscaling process, it has become extremely challenging to further advance the state-of-the-art, especially for large upscaling factors.

arxiv-2108-13686.title: Knowledge-Grounded Dialogue with Reward-Driven Knowledge Selection
arxiv-2108-13686.creator: Shilei Liu, Xiaofeng Zhao, Bochao Li, Feiliang Ren
arxiv-2108-13686.description: Abstract Knowledge-grounded dialogue is a task of generating a fluent and informative response based on both conversation context and a collection of external knowledge, in which knowledge selection plays an important role and attracts more and more research interest. However, most existing models either select only one knowledge or use all knowledge for responses generation.

arxiv-2211-05312.title: Skin values of 208 Pb and 48 Ca determined from reaction cross sections
arxiv-2211-05312.creator: Tomotsugu Wakasa, Shingo Tagami, Masanobu Yahiro
arxiv-2211-05312.description: Abstract Background The PREX and the CREX group reported skin values, r skin 208 ​ ( PREX2 ) = 0.283 ± 0.071 ​ fm r_{\rm skin}^{208}({\rm PREX2})=0.283\pm 0.071\,{\rm fm} and r skin 48 ​ ( CREX ) = 0.121 ± 0.026 ​ ( exp ) ± 0.024 ​ ( model ) r_{\rm skin}^{48}({\rm CREX})=0.121\pm 0.026\ {\rm(exp)}\pm 0.024\ {\rm(model)} fm, respectively.

arxiv-2308-11602.creator: Baian Liu
arxiv-2308-11602.description: Abstract For a numerical semigroup S ≔ ⟨ n 1 , … , n k ⟩ S\coloneqq\langle n_{1},\dots,n_{k}\rangle with minimal generators n 1 < ⋯ < n k n_{1}<\cdots<n_{k} , Barron, O’Neill, and Pelayo showed that L ⁡ ( s + n 1 ) = L ⁡ ( s ) + 1 L(s+n_{1})=L(s)+1 and ℓ ⁡ ( s + n

arxiv-2401-10445.title: Multidimensional Nonhomogeneous Quasi-Linear Systems and Their Hamiltonian Structure
arxiv-2401-10445.creator: Xin HU and Matteo CASATI
arxiv-2401-10445.description: Abstract In this paper, we investigate multidimensional first-order quasi-linear systems and find necessary conditions for them to admit Hamiltonian formulation. The insufficiency of the conditions is related to the Poisson cohomology of the admissible Hamiltonian operators. We present in detail the examples of two-dimensional, two-components systems of hydrodynamic type and of a real reduction of the 3-waves system.

arxiv-2407-03959.title: Skyrmion Hall effect in altermagnets
arxiv-2407-03959.creator: Zhejunyu Jin, Zhaozhuo Zeng, Yunshan Cao, Peng Yan
arxiv-2407-03959.description: Abstract It is widely believed that the skyrmion Hall effect is absent in antiferromagnets because of the vanishing topological charge. However, the Aharonov-Casher theory indicates the possibility of topological effects for neutral particles. In this work, we predict the skyrmion Hall effect in emerging altermagnets with zero net magnetization and zero skyrmion charge.

arxiv-2407-06673.title: CTRL-F: Pairing Convolution with Transformer for Image Classification via Multi-Level Feature Cross-Attention and Representation Learning Fusion
arxiv-2407-06673.creator: Hosam S. EL-Assiouti *, Hadeer El-Saadawy, Maryam N. Al-Berry, Mohamed F. Tolba
arxiv-2407-06673.description: Abstract Transformers have captured growing attention in computer vision, thanks to its large capacity and global processing capabilities. However, transformers are data hungry, and their ability to generalize is constrained compared to Convolutional Neural Networks (ConvNets), especially when trained with limited data due to the absence of the built-in spatial inductive biases present in ConvNets.

arxiv-2411-08902.title: A Range-Free Node Localization Method for Anisotropic Wireless Sensor Networks with Sparse Anchors
arxiv-2411-08902.creator: Yong Jin Member, IEEE, Junfang Leng, Lin Zhou, Member, IEEE, Yu Jiang, Qian Wei, Member, IEEE
arxiv-2411-08902.description: Abstract In sensor networks characterized by irregular layouts and poor connectivity, anisotropic properties can significantly reduce the distance estimation accuracy between nodes, consequently impairing the localization precision of unknown nodes. Since distance estimation is contingent upon the multi-hop paths between anchor node pairs, assigning differential weights based on the reliability of these paths could enhance localization accuracy.

arxiv-2505-16950.title: Bottlenecked Transformers: Periodic KV Cache Consolidation for Generalised Reasoning
arxiv-2505-16950.creator: Adnan Oomerjee, Zafeirios Fountas, Haitham Bou-Ammar, Jun Wang
arxiv-2505-16950.description: Abstract Transformer LLMs have been shown to exhibit strong reasoning ability that scales with inference-time compute, most prominently through token-space “thinking” chains of thought. A growing line of work pushes extra computation into the model’s latent space, which we term Auxiliary Latent-Space Computation (ALSC).

arxiv-2506-19211.title: Hidden Bose-Einstein Singularities of Correlated Electron Systems: III. Thermodynamic Signals
arxiv-2506-19211.creator: Takafumi Kita
arxiv-2506-19211.description: Abstract We study thermodynamic consequences of the hidden Bose-Einstein singularities, which have been predicted to cause a pseudogap phase, based on quantum field theory of ordered phases. Starting from the Luttinger-Ward functional for the grand thermodynamic potential, we derive expressions of the Helmholtz free energy, internal energy, entropy, and heat capacity in a form suitable for numerical studies.

arxiv-2507-21796.title: MoDeSuite: Robot Learning Task Suite for Benchmarking Mobile Manipulation with Deformable Objects
arxiv-2507-21796.creator: Yuying Zhang, Kevin Sebastian Luck, Francesco Verdoja, Ville Kyrki, Joni Pajarinen
arxiv-2507-21796.description: Abstract Mobile manipulation is a critical capability for robots operating in diverse, real-world environments. However, manipulating deformable objects and materials remains a major challenge for existing robot learning algorithms. While various benchmarks have been proposed to evaluate manipulation strategies with rigid objects, there is still a notable lack of standardized benchmarks that address mobile manipulation tasks involving deformable objects.

openalex-w7204549026.creator: Elise Gabrieli Wisniewsky Trevisan, Alan Christhian Bahr, Rafael Ingo Lincoski, Fabíula Aparecida Kurtz, Daiane Aparecida Santore, Liamara Basso Dala Costa, Micheli Martinello, Daniela dos Santos, Bruno Woehl Olekszyszen, Elizama de Gregório, André Trevisan
openalex-w7204549026.source: OpenAlex / Revista Ibero-Americana de Humanidades, Ciências e Educação
openalex-w7204549026.description: O ciclismo é uma atividade física amplamente praticada como esporte, lazer e meio de transporte. Esta revisão narrativa sintetizou evidências sobre seus efeitos nos sistemas nervoso, endócrino e imunológico. Foram realizadas buscas nas bases PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus e Web of...

pmc-10641224.title: Absorption in narrow and wide gap materials
pmc-10641224.creator: Aneer Lamichhane
pmc-10641224.description: The absorption spectrum of a material reveals the absorbed light frequencies, characteristic peaks, and the line width of absorption bands. This information is critical for understanding the energy levels involved in the absorption process as well as the material's electronic structure.

pmc-11432092.title: Parvovirus B19 Infection Is Associated with the Formation of Neutrophil Extracellular Traps and Thrombosis: A Possible Linkage of the VP1 Unique Region
pmc-11432092.creator: Bor-Show Tzang, Hao-Yang Chin, Chih-Chen Tzang, Pei-Hua Chuang, Der-Yuan Chen, Tsai-Ching Hsu, Maurizio Margaglione, Tatiana M Reshetnyak
pmc-11432092.description: Neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) formation, namely NETosis, is implicated in antiphospholipid syndrome (APS)-related thrombosis in various autoimmune disorders such as systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) and APS. Human parvovirus B19 (B19V) infection is closely associated with SLE and APS and causes various clinical manifestations such as blood disorders, joint pain, fever, pregnancy complications, and thrombosis.

pmc-11712190.title: A cluster randomized trial: Exploratory quantitative analysis comparing resident outcomes for two approaches to promote non‐pharmacological, resident‐centered dementia care in nursing homes
pmc-11712190.creator: Victoria Shier, Yuna H. Bae‐Shaaw, Neeraj Sood, Felicia M Chew, Catherine V Piersol, Cara A. Lekovitch, Dominique H. Como, Carin M. Wong, Mike Morris, Natalie E Leland
pmc-11712190.description: BackgroundResident advocates and national nursing home dementia care initiatives have prioritized non‐pharmacological approaches to manage behavioral and psychological symptoms of Alzheimer’s Disease and related dementias. Evidence supports both team‐ and problem‐based approaches to non‐pharmacological dementia care, but the comparative effectiveness of these two approaches has not been examined.

pmc-11724722.title: Angiosarcoma in an Arteriovenous Fistula Following Renal Transplantation: A Case Report and Literature Review
pmc-11724722.creator: Charbel B Aoun, Elie Moukawam, Joseph Sfeir, Ziad Sleiman, George Ghanime
pmc-11724722.description: Angiosarcoma is a rare and aggressive malignant tumor arising from vascular or lymphatic endothelial cells. Angiosarcoma at an arteriovenous fistula site is exceptionally rare. We report a case of a 37-year-old male renal transplant recipient who developed a high-grade epithelioid angiosarcoma at the site of an arteriovenous fistula six years post-transplant.

pmc-12422609.title: Revisiting the Valuation of Child Health-Related Quality of Life
pmc-12422609.creator: Maksat Jumamyradov, Benjamin M. Craig, Michał Jakubczyk
pmc-12422609.description: Objectives:In 2013, the EQ-5D-Y-3L valuation study conducted by Craig and colleagues (ie, the original study) of child health-related quality of life (HRQoL) revealed that U.S. respondents often found it burdensome and guilt-inducing to choose between hypothetical health problems of children. This study introduces an alternative approach where respondents sequentially relieve the health problems of a 10-year-old child for 1 week.

pmc-12692288.title: Development and Characterization of a High-CBD Cannabis Extract Nanoemulsion for Oral Mucosal Delivery
pmc-12692288.creator: Kifah Blal, Georgette Maroukian, Anna Shapira, Shiri Procaccia, David Meiri, Ofra Benny, Alexander Djerdjev
pmc-12692288.description: The cannabidiol (CBD)-rich cannabis extract CAN296 shows anti-inflammatory and anticancer activity relevant to oral lichen planus (OLP), oral graft-versus-host disease (oGVHD), and oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC), but its high lipophilicity limits aqueous dispersion. This study developed a stable Tween-based nanoemulsion optimized for oral mucosal delivery. Ethanol-dissolved CAN296 was nanoemulsified using a 1% Tween/Span system.

pmc-12708226.title: Outcome Analysis of Cohesive Gel Implants With Dual-Plane Technique in Primary Buttock Augmentation
pmc-12708226.creator: Alexander Aslani
pmc-12708226.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background:Buttock augmentation is increasingly popular in body contouring but remains controversial within the surgical community, partly due to limited larger scale studies on cohesive gel buttock implants, in contrast to the extensive data available for breast implants.

pmc-12750731.title: Comparison of catheter outcomes according to dialysis modality and clinical factors in patients with femoral dialysis catheters
pmc-12750731.creator: A-Young Kim, Kyu Hyang Cho, Jong Won Park, Jun Young Do, Seok Hui Kang
pmc-12750731.description: BackgroundAlthough femoral vein catheters are less preferred than internal jugular vein catheters, they are still actively used as an alternative. However, limited studies have assessed whether the patency of femoral vein catheters differs according to the initial dialysis modality. We compared and analyzed femoral vein catheter outcomes according to the initial dialysis modality and clinical factors.

pmc-13278766.title: QproMS: a web application for label-free proteomic data analysis
pmc-13278766.creator: Fabio Bedin, Giorgia Cucina, Giampaolo Martinello, Stefano Rizzieri, Andrea Graziadei, Alessandro Cuomo, Nurcan Tunçbağ
pmc-13278766.description: MotivationProteomics has experienced substantial growth in methods and data analysis approaches, with the development of new data-dependent (DDA) and data-independent acquisition (DIA) workflow and several search engine algorithms and software packages. Each of these workflows has its unique data analysis package that performs data reduction, missing value imputation, statistical testing, and visualization. Often, these tools are designed for expert users.

pmc-13527121.title: A systematic narrative review of the form, process, and function of sensory hyposensitivity in depression
pmc-13527121.creator: Christopher F Sharpley, G Lorenzo Odierna, Vicki Bitsika, Christopher B Watson

pmc-13547215.title: Agricultural sustainability monitoring in arid regions using hybrid deep learning and Landsat 8 imagery in Najran City, Saudi Arabia
pmc-13547215.creator: Yousef Asiri, Eman A. Alshari, Aisha M. Mashraqi, Ebrahim Mohammed Senan, Hanan T. Halawani, Bandar Hussein Edah Althagafi

pmc-13548342.title: Dissecting Bone Marrow Fibrosis in Philadelphia‐Negative Myeloproliferative Neoplasms: Multiple Roads Lead to Rome
pmc-13548342.creator: Mariagiovanna Ballato, Vincenzo Fiorentino, Gabriele Ricciardi, Pietro Tralongo, Emanuela Germanà, Alessandro Allegra, Fabio Stagno, Guido Fadda, Maurizio Martini
pmc-13548342.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Philadelphia‐negative myeloproliferative neoplasms (MPN), a spectrum of blood malignancies characterized by uncontrolled myeloid proliferation, persist as a key challenge in onco‐hematology due to their intricate molecular background, heterogeneous clinical phenotypes, and variable prognoses. Although generally accepted as indolent disorders, a considerable fraction of MPN patients exhibit progressive, and sometimes accelerated, bone marrow fibrosis, reflecting a critical shift toward a more debilitating condition marked by an increased symptom burden.

pmc-13607593.title: Mechanisms of Piezo1-Mediated Mechanotransduction in Thrombotic Diseases
pmc-13607593.creator: Hanrong Dong, Yunlun Li, Wenqing Yang
pmc-13607593.description: The mechanical cation channel Piezo1 has been confirmed as a key membrane mechanical protein that can convert physical forces into biological signals, serving as a molecular hub linking hemodynamic stimulation with thrombotic diseases. Studying mechanical sensitive channels in the cardiovascular system is helpful for understanding the working mechanism of these channels and providing new therapeutic targets for thrombotic diseases.

pmc-13669324.title: Preclinical and clinical investigation of VES001, an oral small molecule sortilin receptor inhibitor for the treatment of frontotemporal dementia: a first-in-human randomized placebo-controlled phase 1 trial
pmc-13669324.creator: Louise Klem, Daniel Dumas, Imogen J Swift, Sofie L Frandsen, Ditte Nedergaard Mikkelsen, Laerke Fensbaek, Yalçin Yavuz, Okke Merton, Jesminne Castricum, Simone Prichardt, Graham M Wynne, Anders Riisager, Nina Schultz, Paul B Little, Ove Pedersen, Eva Thijssen, Anders Nykjaer, Philip Kremer, Mads Kjo
pmc-13669324.description: GRN haploinsufficiency reduces progranulin and causes frontotemporal dementia (FTD-GRN). VES001, an oral small-molecule sortilin inhibitor, increases progranulin without downregulating sortilin. Preclinically, VES001 bound sortilin selectively and elevated progranulin in plasma, cerebrospinal fluid (CSF), and hippocampal interstitial fluid of male rats.

pmc-13694171.title: Changes in Burnout and Other Types of Emotional Distress Among KUSM Medical Students Between 2019 and 2025
pmc-13694171.creator: Samuel Ofei-Dodoo, Rosey Zackula
pmc-13694171.description: BackgroundBurnout among medical students is associated with depression, fatigue, suicidal ideation, and impaired academic performance. Authors evaluated changes in burnout and well-being among medical students at the University of Kansas School of Medicine (KUSM) between 2019 and 2025 and explored students’ perspectives on promoting wellness.MethodsA repeated cross-sectional, anonymous online survey was administered to all KUSM medical students in 2025.
